senses.gloss: Gauśra (‘descendant of Guśri’) is the name of a teacher mentioned in the kauṣītaki brāhmaṇa (xvi. 9; xxiii. 5). See gauśla.
Gauśrāyaṇi (‘descendant of Gauśra’) is the patronymic of a teacher, citra, in the kauṣītaki brāhmaṇa (xxiii. 5).

Gauśla, a variant of gauśra, is the name of a teacher represented as in disagreement with Buḍila āśvatara āśvi in the aitareya brāhmaṇa.
Foot notes vi. 30. Cf. Gopatha brāhmaṇa, ii. 6, 9 (Gośla).
